Hymn 301: I Am a Child of God
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Mildred Tanner Pettit
Lyricist/Text Author: Naomi W. Randall
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 301 titled "I Am a Child of God" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Mildred Tanner Pettit and the lyrics were written by Naomi W. Randall.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
